./main.go:25:11: hold(&c) lends back a pointer its caller owns, and it is kept in keepC, so the object has two owners
    in Rust the result borrows the argument, and lasts only while the argument is unchanged (RFC 0017)
    a new local is such a borrow when the argument is a pointer variable, p := f(x); hold(&c) lends another argument, not supported yet
    read through the result or pass it to a call where it is returned, or keep the argument's own pointer instead
